question: What doctrinal power is claimed for one engaged in constant meditation with regard to showing one's own body in many ways?
premises: The power to show is attributed to the practitioner.
The object shown is one's own body.
This power arises by constant meditation and manifests in many ways.
inference: By constant meditation, the practitioner is claimed to be able to show one's own body in many ways.
uncertainties: The subject 'he' is presupposed as the accomplished practitioner.
plain_english: By constant meditation, one may show one's own body in many ways.
